# Laura Clarke Administrative Services

> Independent, private administrative service based in St. Catherine, Jamaica, run by Laura Clarke. Services are delivered remotely, with no office visits needed. Our main focus is helping self-employed Jamaicans file their taxes online through the TAJ website. We also handle driver's licence and motor vehicle licence renewals, traffic ticket lookups and payments, Jamaican passport renewals, US visitor visa forms and police record applications, for clients in Jamaica and overseas. We are not a government agency and are not affiliated with the Government of Jamaica. Government fees are paid to the agency and are separate from our service fee.

How to start: send your details on WhatsApp: +1 (876) 561-2614, through the start page (https://documenthelpja.com/start.html) or the contact page (https://documenthelpja.com/contact.html). Each service page also has a short check and a start button. Email: info@documenthelpja.com. We review each request, then send an invoice; work begins once payment has cleared. Payment is by bank transfer or Lynk, from an account in the client's own name. Fees are confirmed with the client before any work starts and are paid in full upfront. Fees on this site were last checked November 2026 and can change; the service page shows the current fee. If a document is not listed here, ask: Laura says whether she can help.

## Services

### Self-employed

- File and pay your taxes online: tax returns for the self-employed now go through the TAJ website only. We set up the client's TAJ online account (log in, see what is owed, pay, find tax notices) and file the self-employed return (the S04) online, with the client or for them. We never ask for the client's TAJ password: the client adds us as an authorised third party on their own TAJ profile and can remove that access at any time. Filing regularly can lead to a Tax Compliance Certificate (TCC), which serves as proof of income for visa, loan and bank applications, and keeps NHT and NIS contributions on record; it supports those applications but does not guarantee them. This is administrative support, not tax advice. Ask on WhatsApp.
- [S04 Tax Record Planner](https://documenthelpja.com/s04-tax-record-planner): A record-keeping PDF for self-employed Jamaicans filing the S04 on the TAJ website. J$2,000, bought on WhatsApp, paid by Lynk or bank transfer, download link sent on WhatsApp.
- S04 Income and Expense Tracker: free record-keeping PDF, sent on request through WhatsApp: +1 (876) 561-2614.
- Both are record-keeping tools, not tax advice.
- Book, coming December 2026: "Don't Pay Tax You Don't Owe", a plain-language walkthrough of filing the self-employed return on the TAJ website. Sign up on the homepage to be told when it is out.

### Driver & vehicle

- [Driver's licence renewal](https://documenthelpja.com/drivers-licence-renewal.html): We pay the TAJ fee online, so the driver is road-ready the same day with the receipt, and prepare everything for collecting the new card at TAJ. Our fee J$4,000 plus TAJ's fee (Class B J$5,400, Class C J$7,200). The page also explains Jamaica's demerit points system and where it stands (the page shows the date it was last checked), what to do about unpaid tickets and missed court dates, and where to contact the courts and the JCF about them.
- [Motor vehicle licence renewal](https://documenthelpja.com/motor-vehicle-licence-renewal.html): Same-day online renewal, no Tax Office line, when insurance and fitness are valid: J$4,000 plus TAJ's fee. With an expired fitness: J$5,000 plus TAJ's fees, and the owner takes the vehicle for inspection. Fitness fee payment on its own: J$1,500. The registration certificate comes by email.
- Traffic tickets: we check everything outstanding on the licence and give the client a printout. The lookup is free, whether or not they use our payment service. If a ticket can still be paid online, we pay it for the client: our fee J$2,000, separate from the ticket amount. Tickets must be cleared before a renewal. Tickets past their court date cannot be paid online; the client takes the printout to court. Start on the driver's licence page (https://documenthelpja.com/drivers-licence-renewal.html) or ask on WhatsApp.

### Travel documents: passport, visa & police record

- [Online passport renewal](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaican-passport-services.html): Digital (online) renewals for adults who qualify under PICA's rules. A short eligibility check on the page confirms it. We check the documents and photo, apply, pay PICA and track it to the client's door. In Jamaica: our fee J$3,500 plus PICA's fee from J$8,850, courier included. Overseas: our fee US$70 plus PICA's fee and courier, which depends on location. We do not handle children's passports, first passports, lost, stolen or damaged passports, or paper renewals; the page explains what those applicants need to do at PICA.
- [US visitor visa (B1/B2) help](https://documenthelpja.com/us-visitor-visa-services.html): We fill in the DS-160 form with the client, in person or by video call, pay the visa fee with them and send in the documents. Renewals: J$10,000. New applicants start with a J$5,000 consultation, then the J$10,000 visa service when their documents are ready. The US$185 visa fee is paid by the client to the US government. We are not connected to the US Embassy and cannot guarantee approval.
- [Police record application](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-police-record.html): In Jamaica, we complete the online application, pay the JCF fee and book the fingerprinting appointment; the applicant attends for biometrics. Our fee J$5,000 plus the JCF fee (J$3,000 regular, J$6,000 express, J$8,000 next day in Kingston when offered).

### Other

- [Birth and marriage certificates (RGD)](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaican-rgd-certificates.html): Offered on request. Certified copies ordered from the RGD and sent by DHL, or collected in person. Records that need a search first, or have errors, are handled after a consultation. Our fee is confirmed once we review the request. RGD fees: J$4,000 regular, J$6,000 express, J$1,000 per decade searched.
- Other administrative help: online forms, email correspondence, follow-up enquiries or supporting documents. Tell us what is needed and we say whether we can help: https://documenthelpja.com/contact.html
- [Digital business card](https://documenthelpja.com/card.html): Contact download and WhatsApp.

## Free guides (information only)

- [Working for yourself in Jamaica? Start here](https://documenthelpja.com/self-employed-s04-tax-guide): The starting guide for the self-employed and people with a side business: what the S04 and S04A are, the March 15 filing date and quarterly payment dates, getting records ready, online filing, and which guide to read next.
- [Why might NIS still be payable?](https://documenthelpja.com/self-employed-nis-minimum-jamaica): Why low business income, or no income tax to pay, does not settle the NIS question; the J$250-a-week minimum category and the J$13,000 illustration, and what to check if you also have a job.
- [Behind on your S04 returns or payments? Where to start](https://documenthelpja.com/self-employed-tax-traps-jamaica): Six steps: gather records, find what is outstanding, deal with assessment notices (online objection within 30 days of service), check and file missing returns, pay or talk to TAJ, and keep up with S04A estimates.
- [Are your NIS contributions on record?](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-nis-guide): For employees and the self-employed: what to ask NIS after changing jobs, changing your name or starting a business, what to gather, and voluntary contributions. We do not handle NIS record checks or benefit claims.
- [Jamaican passport overview](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-passport-guide): Which passport route fits, speed options and what PICA checks.
- [PICA card payment failed](https://documenthelpja.com/pica-card-payment-failed): What to check if your PICA online renewal payment fails: a declined card, a locked application, or a payment your bank shows that PICA has not confirmed. The one rule: do not pay twice until PICA confirms.
- [US visitor visa (B1/B2) from Jamaica](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-us-visitor-visa-guide): Whether a visitor visa fits your visit, what only the applicant can do, the US$185 fee and timing, renewals and common questions. Not a step-by-step guide; our service page explains the help we offer.
- [H-2B work visa: steps and scam checks](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-h2b-work-visa-guide): How to stay safe: check the agency with the Ministry of Labour and Social Security before paying or sending a passport, what to do if someone asks for money, why no one can guarantee a visa, and the Ministry's own programme. The full process is in the free toolkit PDF. We do not recruit or place workers.
- [Citizenship by descent](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaican-citizenship-by-descent): Who qualifies and the documents PICA needs.
- [Coming home? Start your Jamaican citizenship while you're here](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaican-citizenship-while-home)
- [Learner's permit guide](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-learners-permit-guide.html)
- [Birth and marriage certificates guide](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-rgd-certificates-guide)
- [C5 travel form and barrel clearance](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-c5-travel-form): Information only; we do not offer customs clearance.
- [Free kits](https://documenthelpja.com/free-kits): Printable PDFs, no sign-up: Tax Backlog Recovery Guide and H-2B Process Guide and Toolkit.
